question: What is the IUPAC name of glycerol?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Propane-1, 2, 3-triol**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Propane-1, 2, 3-triol** is the IUPAC name for glycerol.
 
• Glycerol, also known as glycerin, is a simple polyol compound.
 
• It is a colorless, odorless, viscous liquid that is sweet-tasting and non-toxic.
